description: EXPLORATORY (D-668, program U's U5): the contract's value map -- P-14's and P-16's state tables re-solved at $50K at the bound edge (D-667's solves), every held state's value, leaf, the value of a win over a loss and the edge a dollar is worth; where accounts spend their days (the solver's forward; beside, the registered campaigns' records); the campaign value of +1 point of win probability by place of an account's life; the bar a signal of a given frequency must clear. The identities first (section identity). No seed of its own (an exact chain; the records at the registered seeds).

notes.status: EXPLORATORY (D-668): a reading of the solved tables; no campaign run for it, no variant counted, selects nothing
notes.value_model: every value is the table's model's -- a state's continuation under the solver, not a campaign's cash path (D-668 (5))

interpretations: The re-solve is D-667's own solve (scripts/u_size_fit.solve) at $50K and the bound edge set; D-667 wrote no table for its bound solves, so 'equals D-667's solve' is checked on its rent and every reading it wrote for that solve (to 1e-9), with the solver's code unchanged since D-667's commit; the exported table's sha256 is recorded.

The solver's outcome is binary per rung: a win (its target at the action's R on the $50 grid, or in the evaluation the need-aware or consistency exit the solver applies) or a loss of the realised stake (cut to the room; at the floor the account ends, worth 0); the race against the floor lowers p and adds no outcome. The gate's shifted outcome distribution enters only as each R's lower win probability (its lb_by_rr); the solver has no intraday partial outcomes (no scratch, time exit or partial fill). dv is the value after the win outcome less after the stop outcome.

dv is read at the next session's value: for a funded or paid account the value at the close after the trade, the table's payout choice there included; for the evaluation the next session's value, a pass worth the funded account's value over the days left less the activation fee (the solver's pass value).

dv per state and day is averaged over the rungs by the rung's share times the share of its trades offering the action's R (conditional on a trade being taken); p_trade is that weight's sum. Per state, value and p_trade are occupancy-weighted over the days the state is held and dv is trade-weighted (occupancy x p_trade); the leaf shown is the action holding most of the state's occupancy.
Values are the solver's objective: expected cash within the 504-session horizon less lambda* a live account-day (the evaluation's subscription accrued per day as well).

The occupancy is the solver's forward: a fresh evaluation run to its pass, failure or abandonment; a fresh funded account run over the whole horizon from session 0 (the table's cycle accounting, as D-667's readings and state_policy_dp.cycle_rate read it), its unpaid states up to its first payout and its paid states after. A session on which the table abandons holds no account-day.

The place values are first-order: with the table held fixed, +dp on every trade of a place changes an attempt's value by dp x sum(occupancy x p_trade x dv) over the place (exact at a fixed table, tested against a perturbed table; a re-solved table gains the same to first order). Per trade affected: dp x the trade-weighted mean dv.

Place (c), the funded opening, is each funded account's first trade: the forward's mass at the fresh state that has never traded (every trade leaves the fresh state, so this is a layer of its own); (d) is the rest of the unpaid states' trades; (e) the paid states'; (b) the evaluation's; (a) all of them, a funded place per attempt counted at P(pass) times its funded figure.

Per year of a five-seat campaign, forward basis: trades of the place an attempt x attempts a seat-year (252 sessions over the slot-days an attempt holds: the evaluation's days plus P(pass) times the funded account's, as cycle_rate counts them) x 5 seats -- the table's model, every seat an independent account trading whenever its leaf trades. Records basis, beside: the place's trades a year in U2's re-run of the registered campaign (its first 100 paths at the bound arm, 504 sessions = 2 years), whose router, budget and strict one-at-a-time rule limit the trades -- and which trades the table on file (solved at FV3-C's single edge), not this re-solve.

The bar: extra win probability = target / (uses x the place's mean dv), uses = the frequency N or, where the place offers fewer trades a year on that basis, that supply (flagged 'capped'); the best place is the single place (b to e) with the highest mean dv; 'every trade' uses place (a).

The records' state at a session's start is the account's previous recorded close (the fresh start on its first session); it is banded by the exported table's bands, because the engine's balances leave the $50 grid (costs) and its records carry no winning-day count; a funded session is 'paid' after the session of the first payout request (the engine's first_payout_day).

The state section lists the states holding at least 0.0001 of their phase's account-days; the phase rows give how many states are held and the share listed. Every phase total and place value uses every state.

places.c_funded_opening: (c) the funded account's opening trade only
places.d_funded_later: (d) the funded account's later trades before its first payout
